title: Failure Prediction
description: Contextual failure prediction with confidence scoring and recovery routing. Generated at plan-time, not at failure-time.

failure_type.description: The specific failure mode being predicted

confidence.description: Probability this failure will occur given the current plan (0.0 = impossible, 1.0 = certain)

reason.description: Why this failure is predicted (e.g., 'FP16 70B model requires 156GB VRAM but gpu-x-large offers 48GB')

mitigation.description: Specific action to prevent or recover from this failure

prevention_applied.description: Whether the architect already applied a prevention measure in the generated plan

recovery_operator.description: Which operator skill should handle recovery if this failure occurs

severity.description: Impact severity if the failure occurs
